split_policy.primary_axis: IR fixture role before fixture path convenience, diagnostic sidecar, conformance manifest row, generated artifact pointer, runtime-dispatch symbol, or retired-surface tag
split_policy.positive_rule: IR positives are hand-authored tests/native/ir fixtures with fixture_kind=positive, canonical_behavior_source=true, and retired_positive_surface=false
split_policy.strict_error_rule: non-nil runtime helper calls and unresolved runtime-dispatch symbols are strict-error/linkage evidence; they are not positive IR support
split_policy.docs_evidence_rule: owner index rows, phase contracts, module-roundtrip manifests, lowering-ABI manifests, report pointers, generated artifact pointers, and metadata field names are provenance unless tied to an IR fixture sidecar
split_policy.rejection_rule: old-mode, shim, fallback, generated-only, report-only, and migration-only IR rows are rejection or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.omitted_phase_rule: this family has no parser, sema, lowering, runtime, or e2e behavior contracts
